identity.affine_arithmetic: Arb encloses c0+exact_delta*v and alpha0+exact_delta*w before all fixed base weights
identity.parameter_arithmetic: First form complete exact center and direction scalar polynomials; then add the single p in [-eta,eta]. No independent raw-control parameter intervals are introduced.
identity.exact_delta_fraction_scope: The exact_delta_fraction field names the center only; all bounds cover the separately stated whole exact_parameter_interval.

exact_finite_definition: For even fields g_i,k=c_i,k and g_i,-k=c_i,k. For odd b,sigma,v, g_i,k=i*c_i,k, g_i,-k=-i*c_i,k and c_i,0=0. Sum u^i exp(4ik theta) over the saved complete finite rectangle.
scope: Actual a,b,c,tau,sigma,alpha=1/a,v=b/a,gamma=b*v-c,kappa=-K0 on the whole real leaf and eta family. Complete physical theta derivatives 0..2 of the value error and physical-r derivative error are paid. A strict-negative energy consumer must additionally prove alpha,gamma,kappa positive; no such positivity is inferred merely from this coefficient package.
